title: docs(skills): notify selectors say when org:members reaches nobody and show the computed owner_of: form

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMCv7LS8oNqc7y47FubgYPN)_

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5m6cFuoP5TBSv16TZ4

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-automation` 技能 § `notify` 的两条受众选择器各补一句:`org:members` 在 `single` 形态下既无运行组织、也无通知所指记录时谁也收不到(例:开始节点未声明 `organization`、无记录的 `schedule` 流程),只在服务器日志告警,节点照样成功;`owner_of:OBJECT:ID` 给出流程真正要写的形式,用表达式拼出 id(`source: "'owner_of:crm_case:' + record.case_id"`)。
- 为什么改:PR #32841 的契约复审留下两条 should-fix(S1、S2);照旧技能写出的通知会静默送达零人,或要 AI 自己推导 `owner_of:` 的可用写法。`flows.mdx` 早已写明前一条。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字,不动 schema 与运行时;token 6857 到 6859(上限 6861,未抬上限),新增由同文件四处复述删减付账;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 第 132–133 行(两条选择器);再看第 108 行与 Assignment rules、Who may START 两处删去的 ADR 旁注。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 exit 0、`objectstack-automation/SKILL.md is 6859 tokens (ceiling 6861; headroom 2)`。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` § `notify`, the `org:members` line (card Part 1, review S1).** It now ends "else nobody (`single` posture: a `schedule` flow declaring no `organization`, no record)", says any other `org:` value reaches nobody too, and says where the warning goes and what the node does: "Each warns in the server log only; the node succeeds." This also answers review nit N1 ("with a warning" did not say where).
- **The `owner_of:OBJECT:ID` line (card Part 2, review S2).** It now shows the computed form once: `source: "'owner_of:crm_case:' + record.case_id"`.
- **Paid in the same file** (headroom was 4 tokens; the card carries no maintainer words ordering a raise, so no ceiling moved):
  - § `notify` lead: "`NotifyConfigSchema` is `strictObject` —" before "an undeclared key is a named parse error", which says the same thing in the words an author acts on.
  - Three ADR asides that teach nothing an author writes: "(ADR-0066 D4)" on Who may START a flow, "(ADR-0142 D5)" in Assignment rules, "(ADR-0150 D3)" on A packaged rule's queue. The section headings and anchors are unchanged ("(ADR-0041 Tier 1)" in the Inbound webhook heading stays, so no anchor moves).
  - Silently-wrong item 3: "Data-lifecycle **side effects** (read/write other records) are an L2 **hook** (objectstack-data)." Its homes: the same item's bold lead ("A flow `function` is a PURE compute step — it does NOT read/write the database") with "a later **declarative** node persists it", and the skill's own description ("Do not use for data lifecycle hooks at the object layer (see objectstack-data)"). Eval case 5 (the `script` case) expects pure compute and a following `update_record`, both still taught.
  - Two re-wraps (the § `notify` lead and the Who may START callout) only re-flow lines the cuts shortened; they are not counted as payment.
- **`.changeset/32961-notify-org-members-nobody-owner-of-form.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines.

## Why

Part 1 re-measured on `origin/main` 03dc6267, not taken from the card:

- **A `schedule` run can carry no organization.** `packages/triggers/trigger-schedule/src/schedule-trigger.ts:803` reads the binding's organization; `:886` spreads `tenantId` only when it is not `null` (the ruling-G `single` posture, comment `:868-885`).
- **The notify node passes the run's organization, else the record's.** `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts:1213` (`context.tenantId`), `:1230-1239` (`organizationOfRecordAbout`: the click-through record, else the trigger record). No record and no `tenantId` leaves it undefined.
- **The resolver reads the producer's organization.** `packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service.ts:1419-1420` passes `input.organizationId`, not the organization the engine stamps on the event row (`:1400-1402`).
- **No organization: a server-log warning and nobody.** `packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts:233-239` warns "this emit names no organization; 0 recipients" and returns `[]`; any other `org:` value warns at `:173-175`.
- **The node still succeeds.** `notify-node.ts:1307` returns `success: true` with `delivered: 0`; `deliveryFailureWarning` (`:99-103`) adds a step warning only for a failed delivery, so the run history shows none.
- **Docs agree.** `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:346-349`: "where there is none, `org:members` reaches nobody … each with a warning in the server log".

Part 2: the `owner_of:` string is a recipient "written or evaluated" (the line above the list), so an envelope that evaluates to `'owner_of:crm_case:ID'` reaches that record's owner; the review record 6836991260 read the same path.

## Acceptance notes

- **Round 2 (head `7cc0ff03`, review record 6887230505 should-fix):** the case is named as the `single` posture. Under `group` the `sys_notification` write in `emit()` is refused (`ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`) before the audience is resolved and the node returns `success: false` (`notify-node.ts:1385-1394`); under `isolated` an undeclared schedule flow never binds. The remedy is named by spelling the start-node key `organization` (`SCHEDULE_ORGANIZATION_KEY`, `packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts:159`), +20 bytes inside the headroom. Nit not taken (no budget): the `{ dialect: 'cel' }` wrapper on the `owner_of:` example; item 1 and the `notify` fence already show the envelope.
- **Part 1 is taught, not changed** (order ruling). One reading for the owning lane, not filed here: in the `single` posture the engine stamps the sole organization on the `sys_notification` row (`messaging-service.ts:1400-1402`), yet the resolver is handed the producer's (`:1419-1420`, comment "The organization is the producer's, as role: has always read it"), so `org:members` reaches nobody where the deployment's one organization is known. The comment states this as intended, so it is reported to the seat as an observation, not as a defect.
- **Review nit N2 not taken:** the fence comment "An envelope must yield USER ids" still sits above the selector list; the list's "written or evaluated" is the more specific line, and the fence is an `os:check` block (left untouched).
- No eval changed: `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/*.json` hold no assertion on these two lines or on the cut phrases (`git grep` of each cut phrase over `skills`, `packages`, `scripts`, `content`, `.claude`: no test, script or eval pins one).

## Verification

Round 1 head `d9a512bb`; round 2 head `7cc0ff03` reran the same 46 derived families plus `check:skill-refs` and `check:skill-examples` with the same result (45 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 NOT MEASURED; record `32961-gates-ran-r2.txt`). Base `origin/main` 03dc6267 (`origin/main` later moved to a9da5474 with no commit touching `skills/objectstack-automation` or the ratchet script).

- Whole package, all `skills/*/SKILL.md`: 4597 to 4593 lines, about 59056 to 59053 tokens (ceil(bytes/4) per file).

</details>
